master.reference: Existing ndex_icon_256.png before this UI update
master.prompt: Edit the existing NDEX app icon. Make only the white background outside the black rounded-square silhouette fully transparent. Preserve the black rounded-square body, white open frame, exact two-row N/reverse-D and E/X lettering, orange E bar and orange lower-right bent corner, relative positions, proportions, stroke thickness and palette. No new typography, matte, shadow, glow, border or padding. Clean antialiased silhouette on true transparent alpha. This is a desktop icon background correction, not a redesign.

small.method: Code-native vector artwork for 16px and 24px resources
small.design: Simplified white N and orange corner on the existing black rounded tile. Removes the detailed frame and extra lettering at small sizes.

original_sources: ndex_icon_source.png and the wordmark sources are retained unchanged.
